notes: Connected Apps is its own page, out of Ervo Stats; Settings lost the Greeting and Weather rows
The greeting is just "Hi Erick, what can I help you with today?"; tell Ervo "call me …" to change the name
Android: when you close Ervo, one short weather line (temperature and sky), with a brief caution only for storms, snow, rain, very hot, very cold or strong wind; at most every 3 hours, never at night
Ervo Stats: the Back button works again and the page moves smoothly; the sky animates on the graphics chip instead of repainting the screen
Switching between Personal and Business is one smooth transition, with no flash in between
Switching between Personal and Business shows the look you picked for that Ervo, with no flash of the default owl

Orders, returns and refunds as cards: a progress bar from Ordered to Delivered (or Requested to Refunded), the arrival date, the tracking number, and buttons to open the store's own orders page or the carrier. Tell Ervo about an order, paste a tracking number or send a photo of the order email

60 stores and services Ervo can open for orders and returns: Amazon, Walmart, Target, Costco, eBay, Etsy, Temu, Shein, Best Buy, Nike, Zara, DoorDash, Uber Eats, Instacart, Domino's, CVS and more, plus UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL tracking
A Files tab for Orders, where every card lives with its progress
"What do I have today?" shows the day as a card with a 3D icon per event and the time; Open calendar brings up a month with dots on busy days
Glass everywhere: frosted cards, sheets and bubbles with a hairline highlight, tuned for light and dark
The status pill only ever says simple things like Researching, Planning or Writing a draft, never your own words
highlights: Connected Apps has its own page; Settings is shorter
A short weather note when you close Ervo, with a caution only when it is bad
Say "call me Rick" and Ervo uses it
